articles.title: SpaceX Rocket About to Do Something No Rocket Has Ever Done!
articles.summary: A SpaceX rocket is about to launch for the 37th time — a new record! It's carrying 29 internet satellites. Watch it live early Tuesday morning!

articles.title: Real-Life Dragon Found in Thailand — Named After a TV Dragon!
articles.summary: Scientists found a new lizard in Thailand that looks like a tiny dragon. They named it Syrax, after the dragon from House of the Dragon. It's yellow-green and lives high in the mountains!

articles.title: Your Medicine Might Change Your Gut for Years — Even After You Stop!
articles.summary: A big study found that medicines like antibiotics and anxiety drugs can change the bacteria in your gut for years after you stop taking them. That's why your gut might be different from your friend's!
